title: Authorities seize P2.2M in contraband cigarettes in Sultan Kudarat town

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, Philippines — Police authorities in Sultan Kudarat province seized a haul of suspected smuggled cigarettes during a joint seaborne patrol at around 4:30 p.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 27, in the waters off Kalamansig town.
